proposal.thesis: ServiceNow is the cleanest no-supply pullback in today's deep pack: weekly structure still up, RSI mid-50s, last ~135.6 vs yesterday's 137.68 close, and volume read is no_supply_pullback while GPU/server names sprint. Digest shows Q ended 2026-06-30 revenue $3.99B (+29% y/y), FCF TTM ~$4.6B, net debt/EBITDA ~1.2 — a cash compounder, not a story stock. On a day-0 $1000 book I want seat #1 in software/AI platforms with different demand_driver than hyperscaler server hardware, so the book is not a single-factor AI-capex clone from bar one.
catalysts: Next 2-4 weeks: evidence of AI Control Tower / workflow attach in customer commentary and sell-side estimate stability into late-October print window
Hold of the current base above ~130 with market still supportive (SPY above 200-DMA)
proposal.macro_context: Supportive equity regime (SPY above 200-DMA, calm VIX) with rising yields — prefer FCF-positive platform software over richly gapped semiconductor duration. NOW's cash generation fits that regime better than chasing AMD/ARM day-momentum.
proposal.risk_map: Trade dies if NOW loses the pullback structure on rising volume (close through 125 stop), if software multiples compress hard on a rates spike (watch 10y and HY OAS), or if pre-announcement commentary into the late-October print implies AI monetization slipping. Early tells: break of 50-DMA with expanding volume, or a sharp relative lag vs CRWD/S while the tape is fine.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: street treats NOW as a quality compounder already priced for steady 20%+ growth; the tape today is rotating attention to AI hardware winners (AMD/ARM headlines) so NOW's quiet pullback looks like indifference rather than a new thesis. MY VIEW: the mispricing is relative — platform AI attach and workflow consolidation stay under-owned versus GPU day-momentum, and a mid-base entry with RSI 55 is a better swing geometry than buying the hardware sprint. MECHANISM: sell-side and momentum flows overweight near-term AI semiconductor prints and underweight multi-quarter software attach that shows up in net expansion and FCF, so NOW can drift on low supply while the narrative is elsewhere. RESOLUTION: by the late-October 2026 earnings window (digest next_earnings 2026-10-28), either AI product attach / cRPO commentary confirms the platform story or the relative underperformance continues and the thesis is wrong.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: Late-October 2026 earnings or guide that cuts cRPO/net expansion or shows AI attach stalling versus the prior quarter's trajectory.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: Daily close below 125 on rising volume, or a decisive break and close under the 50-DMA while SPY remains above its 200-DMA (stock-specific failure).
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If NOW has not reclaimed and held above 145 within 30 calendar days of entry, cut or exit — the pullback thesis will have failed to resolve.

proposal.risk_desk_note: Kill checklist clears hard fails. Falsifiers are specific and observable (late-Oct 2026 cRPO/net-expansion/AI-attach print, daily close below 125, 30-day reclaim/hold of 145). Variant perception is adequate but soft: consensus as a priced quality compounder is not a straw man, mechanism is relative
proposal.sizing_note: risk-clamped from $130 to $54: 0.50% risk budget ($5) / 9.3% stop
